title: AnomaliesRow
description: One row of anomalies.parquet: one signal_cube series scored by one enabled detector (03 §4.1). Written by Anomara for every series and every enabled detector, even below threshold, so evidence can be recomputed.

source.description: Copied from signal_cube.series: metrics, logs or traces (no events).

detector.description: Detector that produced the row (03-anomara §3.2–§3.5, §3.9); tsfm only when the optional plugin is enabled.

score.description: Detector-native score, >= 0: robust_z = max persistent |z| over the incident window; nsigma = raw max |x - mu_B| / sigma'; bocpd = max short-run change-point probability; silence = longest qualifying run / L; tsfm = max persistent residual z.

score_norm.description: log1p-compressed, scale-floored score, comparable across series: log1p(score) exactly for robust_z, bocpd and silence; nsigma uses log1p(max |x - mu_B| / max(sigma_B, epsilon, eta*|mu_B|)) (03-anomara §3.3); tsfm as defined in 03-anomara §3.9.

direction.description: Direction of the deviation: robust_z, nsigma and tsfm use the sign of z at the earliest argmax, flat when score = 0; bocpd uses the sign of the mean standardised value over [onset, onset + p*g), flat without onset; silence is always down (03-anomara §3.2–§3.5, §3.9).

onset_ns.description: Detector onset in source time (not clock-aligned); null when the detector finds none. robust_z and tsfm: start of the first persistent above-threshold run in the incident window; nsigma: first incident point at or above threshold; bocpd: first incident grid point with cp >= threshold, moved back by the most probable short run length; silence: start of the first qualifying run (03-anomara §3.2–§3.5, §3.9).

threshold.description: Threshold this detector applies to score (config/anomara.yaml).

above_threshold.description: score >= threshold (invariant checked by a property test, not by this schema).
